subject: Your Claude Pro subscription renews on August 12, 2026
body-plain:
Hi there,

This is a reminder that your Claude Pro plan renews automatically on August 12, 2026.

Plan:              Claude Pro (individual)
Billing period:    Monthly

Payment method:    Visa ending 4242

Total: $20.00

Your card will be charged on the renewal date. If you would like to make changes, you can cancel by August 11, 2026 and you will keep access until the end of the current billing period.

Manage your subscription: https://claude.ai/settings/billing

Thanks for using Claude,
The Anthropic team
